sections.heading: Birth PRToperator
sections.content: The Birth PRT operator allows you to birth new particles that are copies of particles from a PRTLoader object.

sections.heading: PRT birth
sections.content:
PRT object: the input object that contains PRT particles.Start/End: controls the time range in which to birth new particles.New particles only: controls whether only new particles will be birthed each frame. A particle is considered new if its input ID has not been processed on a previous frame, or its age is 0.

PRT object: the input object that contains PRT particles.

Start/End: controls the time range in which to birth new particles.

New particles only: controls whether only new particles will be birthed each frame. A particle is considered new if its input ID has not been processed on a previous frame, or its age is 0.

sections.heading: Input channels
sections.content:
Channels: controls which PRT data channels to copy into to birthed particles.

Load as custom floats/vectors: unrecognized channels (channels with names that don’t match any of the channels in the default channels list) will be loaded as custom particle properties (floats/vectors, depending on data type).

sections.heading: Settings
sections.content: Flip rotation: flips the w-component of quaternions loaded from PRT data.
